name: demosecurity
description: Open-source, platform-agnostic security and account-protection foundation (NestJS + Mongo/SQLite/Postgres).

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@demosecurity/api && npm run build --workspace=@demosecurity/contracts
scripts.lint: echo "add eslint per workspace when ready"
scripts.docker:up:all: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile mongodb --profile postgres --profile redis up -d
